{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check: should now have 800 unique patient_ids (848 total rows - 48 duplicates)
assert len(df_dedup) == 800, f"Expected 800 patients after deduplication, got {len(df_dedup)}"

# Now, handle the assay_batch unit issue: batch B reports in µg/L, which is 10× larger than ng/mL
# So divide batch-B `biomarker_final` values by 10 to convert to ng/mL
df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].copy()
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_ngml'] /= 10

# Compute the mean of the corrected biomarker_final (in ng/mL)
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'].mean()

mean_biomarker_final"}
